verdict.rationale: Skills can be invoked entirely programmatically via the Messages API (container parameter with skill_id, up to 20 skills per request, Skills API for upload/management), which is inherently headless and usable in automated/CI pipelines rather than requiring a UI. However, there is no explicit documentation or example showing a CI/CD workflow, GitHub Actions integration, or headless CLI invocation of Skills specifically. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation examples, headless-mode CLI docs for skills, and any first-party or community confirmation of running Skills unattended in a pipeline.
